title: Thread milling
description: Parameters of a 'threadmill' operation (cam.h Operation::paramsJson, task T-056): helical thread milling of internal threads (in drilled holes) and external threads (on bosses and pins), with a single-form or a multi-form thread mill, climb or conventional, in one or more radial passes, entering and leaving by a half-circle arc (inside: from the hole's centre). The operation's geometry is a face of each hole (its wall), or the cylindrical face of each boss. The thread's pitch, diameter and hand come from the hole's thread where the model gives one; otherwise they are entered here. Its heights are measured from the highest top of the picked holes and bosses: 'clearance', 'retract' and 'feedPlane'; 'top' and 'bottom' are not used (the thread's length is a parameter or comes from the hole). The cutting feed is the feed at the tool's cutting edge (see 'edgeFeed'); plunge, lead-in and lead-out feeds are the operation's own. Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees. Annotations for editors: 'x-unit' (length, angle, count), 'x-enumTitles' (labels of an enum, in order), 'x-enumDescriptions' (a detail line for each enum value), 'x-relevantWhen' (the property matters only when every named property has one of the listed values), 'x-propertyOrder' (the order of the form), 'x-heightsUsed' and 'x-cuttingUsed' (the members of the operation's heights and cutting data this type reads), 'x-geometry' (what the geometry picker selects: here faces) and 'x-toolTypes' (the tools the picker offers first); docs/operation_types.md defines each.

x-geometry.description: Click the wall of each hole to thread, or the cylinder of each boss for an outside thread.

location.title: Thread
location.description: Inside a hole, or outside a boss or pin.
x-enumDescriptions: In a drilled hole: pick the hole's wall
On a boss or pin: pick its cylinder

form.title: Tool form
form.description: Single-form: a tool with one tooth goes one revolution per pitch over the whole length. Multi-form: a tool with teeth over its flute length at the thread's pitch goes one revolution (and the overlap) per step of its toothed length.
x-enumDescriptions: One revolution per pitch over the whole length
One revolution plus overlap per tool-length step

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.description: The thread's pitch; 0: the hole's thread (from its hole feature). External threads, and holes without a thread in the model, need it.

diameter.title: Major diameter
diameter.description: The thread's major (nominal) diameter; 0: inside, the hole's thread; outside, the cylinder's diameter.

threadLength.title: Thread length
threadLength.description: How far the thread runs down from the top of the bore or the boss; 0: inside, the hole's thread depth, else its whole bore; outside, the whole cylinder.

threadDepth.title: Thread depth
threadDepth.description: The radial depth of the thread; 0: the ISO 68-1 basic profile, 0.5413 x pitch inside (5/8 H) and 0.6134 x pitch outside (17/24 H).

leftHand.title: Left-hand thread
leftHand.description: Cut a left-hand thread: external threads, and holes without a thread spec. A hole with a thread spec is cut by its spec.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Climb or conventional milling; the tool goes up or down the thread to match, by the hand of the thread.

radialPasses.title: Radial passes
radialPasses.description: The thread depth is cut in this many equal steps.

springPass.title: Spring pass
springPass.description: One more pass at the full thread depth.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Multi-form: how far each step turns beyond one revolution, so the start of the cut is cut again.

edgeFeed.title: Feed at the cutting edge
edgeFeed.description: On: the cutting feed is what the cutting edge sees, so the tool centre moves at the feed times its radius over the edge's radius (slower inside a hole, faster outside a boss). Off: the tool centre moves at the cutting feed.
